piece_type: DTC TV ad “CONTRAVE TV Spot 60 Sec_v2” (CON-2306)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “CONTRAVE helps keep those cravings away.” | “Is it hard to lose weight because it can be difficult to control cravings?” | “It is designed to work in 2 ways to help reduce hunger and control cravings.” | ON-SCREEN: “2 Ways Reduce Hunger Control Cravings”
cases.context: People 'smirking defiantly' while putting away chips, chocolates, cookies. PI: “The exact neurochemical effects of CONTRAVE leading to weight loss are not fully understood.” SUPER says mechanism not fully understood but de-emphasized.
cases.rationale: Suggests mechanism and its link to efficacy are fully understood; SUPER undermined by comparative emphasis.
cases.check: Judge: definitive MoA claims ('works in 2 ways') where PI says mechanism not fully understood; check relative emphasis of the qualifier.

cases.claim: [Omission] Major statement omits MG manic episodes risk; “Call a doctor right away if any unusual changes in mood, behaviors, thoughts, or feelings occur.” omits the directive to stop taking Contrave; “Do not take CONTRAVE if you have…history of seizures, . . . . ” but fails to communicate that Contrave can cause seizures
cases.context: Medication Guide 'most important information' and 'possible side effects' sections.
cases.rationale: Omits serious risks and material action directives.
cases.check: Rule: diff major statement vs MG: each serious side effect must appear; HCP-contact statements must include 'stop taking' when MG says so.
